init_video_session: initialize a video inference session for SAM3 Tracker with configurable devices and dtype
add_inputs_to_inference_session: add points, boxes, or masks to a video inference session for a specific frame and object IDs
process_new_points_or_boxes_for_video_fr: process and add point or box prompts to a video frame in the inference session
process_new_mask_for_video_frame: process and add mask inputs to a video frame in the inference session
post_process_masks: post-process output masks by removing padding and upscaling to original image size
